newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Army refuses to accept 27 bodies of soldiers handed over by Tamil rebels through the International Committee of the Red Cross as they were difficult to identify. The soldiers were allegedly killed in the Paranthan battle.
Partly burnt body found at Bolgoda lake, a Colombo suburb.
Tamil rebels in dilemma over fighters wounded in last week's raid on Paranthan army base because of the lack of hospitals to treat them.
Police arrest six pirates at Modera suspected of ferrying arms to Tamil Tiger rebels.
Army recovers 350 bodies of Tamil rebels killed in last Thursday's assault on northern Paranthan military base in which upto 200 soldiers are believed to have died.
Upto 200 soldiers missing after last week's Tamil Tiger rebel raid on Paranthan army base, senior army officer says.
Sarvodaya leader A.T. Ariyaratne planning peace march to north to meet Tamil rebel leaders.
